objective: Execute CCP-02 — Companion Identity, Bond, Intelligence, Agency & Role Model. Define companion profiles, sapience/intelligence, temperament, bond/trust, handler relationships, ownership/control versus voluntary association, permitted roles, needs and provenance while preserving canonical creature identity, MIB-09 relationship authority, sapient agency and all CCP-01 owner routes.
completion_summary: CCP-02 implemented a deterministic companion-profile projection/reference layer with explicit sapience/intelligence, agency, temperament, association, MIB-09 bond-dimension references, owner-routed role declarations, owner-routed need references and provenance. Three synthetic validation profiles cover ordinary-animal, source-confirmed sapient voluntary-partner and familiar/supernatural owner-review cases. Canonical creature/Character identity and MIB-09 relationship state remain external; no numeric bond state, automatic property classification, automatic obedience, universal temperament formula or CCP-03+ mechanics were introduced.
